requests: stardust/rollout/foundation-requests.md (one line per needed foundation change; ship a scoped override in your block CSS meanwhile)
remBase: 17.5px (html, body font-size) — every canon rem value is relative to it

breakpoints.note: min-width queries as in the source (site.css); max-side uses (width < N). sm=767, md=1023, lg=1279, xl=1680

cssCustomProperties.--font-sans: ContinentalStagSansW (owner CDN, weights 300/400/700 + italics) → Arial fallback

globalClasses.richText: .s-richtext (also applied implicitly to main .default-content-wrapper): p/ul margins 1.83rem, underlined links, >=1023 font-size 1.1429rem
globalClasses.icons: .u-icon (1.6rem box, currentColor) + .is-xs/.is-sm/.has-bg/.is-link + brand colours .is-facebook/.is-linkedin/.is-youtube/.is-instagram/.is-tiktok/.is-glassdoor/.is-rss/.is-xing/.is-kununu/.is-x; .icon (100% box for svg/img); .u-icon-plus-minus (+ .is-active)
globalClasses.buttons: EDS button links a.button (p.button-wrapper) and .c-button look like the source c-button: orange pill, slate on hover, ::before arrow icon; a.button[href^=http] → external icon, [href$=.pdf]/[download] → download icon, [href^=mailto:] → mail icon; template classes .c-button.is-internal/.is-external/.is-download/.is-mail
globalClasses.sections: main > .section = o-container band (padding 2.7429rem 0 3.6571rem; >=767 side padding --section-pad-x); default content capped at --content-max. Section-metadata Style values: is-yellow, is-lightgray, is-pastel-yellow/red/blue/green, full-bleed (padding 0), has-image. Sections without a ground get .is-white (adjacent white sections collapse padding-top; first white section padding-top 0; last white section padding-bottom 0).

scripts/utils.js.createIcon(name, {img, tag, className}): filled with inline SVG (currentColor) or when img:true (multi-colour flags)
scripts/utils.js.stripInstrumentation(el): EW4 — strip data-aue-*/data-richtext-* from presentational clones
scripts/utils.js.onStickyChange(cb) / setSticky(on): sticky-header state (scrollY > header bar height, throttled 300ms); body gets .header-is-sticky and body > header gets .is-sticky
scripts/utils.js.equalizeHeights(elements): [data-equalize-height] behaviour: min-height = tallest member, re-run on resize (300ms debounce)
scripts/utils.js.countUp(el, {to, decimals, locale, separ: fact-box count-up 0→to over 2000ms once fully in view
scripts/utils.js.getLocale(): first path segment when it is a locale (en, de, cs-cz…), else 'en'
scripts/utils.js.getCart() / toggleCartItem({href,title},: client-only download cart (localStorage 'download-cart'); fires document 'download-cart-change'; header folder button shows the count and fires 'download-cart-open' on click (no cart panel shipped yet — a block may listen)
scripts/utils.js.fragmentSections(fragment): content sections of a decorated fragment (default-content wrappers, metadata/empty dropped)
scripts/utils.js.itemLink(li): li > a or the pipeline's li > p > a

scripts/lightbox.js.openLightbox(nodeOr{src,type}, {classNam: full-viewport modal (GLightbox look: overlay .92 black, 500ms fade/zoom); a DOM node is moved in and restored on close; images/video/iframe from a src
scripts/lightbox.js.bindLightboxes(root): wires a[data-lightbox] / a.lightbox under root; scripts.js auto-binds main when such links exist after sections load

icons.note: icon names drop the source's icon-con- prefix; chevron-down rotated for up/left/right as in the source

chrome.header: blocks/header — reads /<locale>/nav (or the `nav` metadata row), falls back to /en/nav. Root / uses /en/nav. body > header box = the source header.o-header box (margin-top = source spacer, fixed meta bar above); mega dropdown, off-canvas menu and overlay are fixed children.
chrome.footer: blocks/footer — reads /<locale>/footer (or `footer` metadata), falls back to /en/footer. Inserts section.social-band before <footer> (source c-socialmedia-list) and a fixed .scroll-to-top button.
chrome.navDocument: sections: 1 brand (p>a logo link) | 2 tools (optional global link p>a, country-selector p>a[title=hidden label], language ul (current li without link), p>a[href=#download-cart], search p>a[href=search action][title=aria] text=placeholder, p>strong frequent header + ul, p suggestion labels) | 3 menu labels (p Back, p Select Language, ul offcanvas languages) | one section per main-nav item: h2>a, optional h3>a (dropdown title when it differs), p description/links, nested ul tree (level 1 = dropdown columns, level 2 = column links, deeper = off-canvas only). Items with a ul open the mega dropdown; items without navigate.
chrome.footerDocument: sections: 1 social (p>strong label + ul of links; icon from link text/host) | one per column (p label + ul) | last: p copyright. 4 columns → the 4th is the wide inline column at 767–1022.
chrome.zIndex: header bar 500, scroll-to-top 450, dropdown/off-canvas 401, overlay 400 — blocks stay below 400 unless modal (lightbox 999)

decorateMain: scripts.js: decorateIcons → buildAutoBlocks (fragments, widgets) → decorateSections → section grounds (.is-white) → decorateBlocks → decorateButtons (strong/em-wrapped links → a.button primary/secondary/accent). html[lang] = locale's language (en, de, cs, sk, pt, es, fr, ro).
csp: head.html enforces require-trusted-types-for 'script': build DOM with createElement/append; never assign HTML strings.
